subject: Audit ledger preservation & on-demand export options
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@northriverhealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: NorthRiver Procurement <procurement@northriverhealth.com>
Date: 2025-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit ledger preservation & export needs

Hi Diego,

Quick intro — I lead Compliance at NorthRiver Health. We're preparing for a SIG/SOC2 evidence review and need a clear picture of what Redwood logs, how long those records are preserved, and what export modes you support for on-demand evidence pulls. In particular: 

- We need a signed snapshot (ledger of admin actions + operator context) covering the period 2024-08-01 -> 2025-04-30.
- The auditor will request: per-event timestamp, actor id, action type, target resource, request id, and KV references for cache/state changes.
- Delivery options: SFTP push, pre-signed S3, or an authenticated HTTPS transfer to our secure bucket.

Can you confirm what you can provide, any retention caveats (esp. ephemeral operator events), and whether manifests are HMAC-signed/attested? Also flag any PII redaction steps you perform by default.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lopez
Director, Compliance
NorthRiver Health
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@northriverhealth.com>
Cc: NorthRiver Procurement <procurement@northriverhealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-05-10T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit ledger preservation & export needs

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. High level answer up front: we can produce an attested admin-activity snapshot with per-event metadata, provide HMAC-signed manifests, and deliver via S3 presigned URLs or SFTP shuttle. Below are the specifics and a proposed handoff plan.

What we log (admin/operator ledger):
- Actor: internal user id and role (e.g., user:jane@redwood.ai, role:platform-admin)
- Action: canonical action name (e.g., ROLE_ASSIGN, MODEL_DEPLOY, CONFIG_PATCH)
- Target: resource id (project/pool/model instance)
- Request id / correlation id
- Timestamp (ISO8601, UTC)
- Request payload hash (sha256) and response hash (sha256)
- Context: originating IP (masked on request), session id, agent string
- KV diffs for state-changing admin ops (present as concise deltas)

Retention model / caveats:
- Primary ledger retention: 730 days by default for enterprise customers.
- Ephemeral operator traces (debug-level) are retained for 30 days unless flagged for extended retention during an active audit window.
- PII minimization: we redact full user-submitted content from admin traces by default; actor identifiers are internal ids and email hashes are reversible to owner only via our internal key store (we can include email plaintext when contractually required).

Delivery options we support (pick one or combination):
1) On-demand S3 presigned upload: we push artifacts to your pre-configured S3 path using short-lived presigned PUTs.
2) SFTP shuttle: we push a gzipped bundle to your SFTP endpoint, followed by an HMAC-signed manifest file.
3) HTTPS pull: generate time-limited download bundles behind authenticated token access (useful for auditor pull workflows).

Proposed preserve-and-shuttle plan for your window (recommended):
- Snapshot generation: create chunked JSONL shards (max 10M events / shard) + compressed store.
- Manifest: CSV manifest (admin_activity_snapshot_manifest.csv) listing shard file names, ranges, event counts, and SHA256 checksums. Manifest will be HMAC-SHA256 signed using an export key; we will provide the verification key to your security contact.
- Delivery: default to S3 presigned PUT to s3://nrh-audit-uploads/2025-05-12/. We can instead SFTP if your policies require.

Attachments: draft schema (redwood_audit_schema_v2.pdf) and a short instructions stub (s3_presigned_instructions.txt).

Questions for you to finalize:
- Preferred delivery mode? (S3 presigned / SFTP / HTTPS pull)
- Who should receive the verification key for HMAC manifests? (safety@northriver or audit@northriverhealth.com)
- Any special jurisdictional redaction (e.g., EU PII rules) we should apply before snapshotting?

I can loop in our compliance lead (Kimberly Park) if you want a technical runbook. If you give the delivery mode and recipient for the HMAC key, we'll schedule snapshot generation next week.

— Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@northriverhealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: NorthRiver Procurement <procurement@northriverhealth.com>
Date: 2025-05-11T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit ledger preservation & export needs

Thanks Diego — that sounds good and matches what our auditors will require. A few clarifications: 

- Delivery mode: S3 presigned PUT is preferred (we have an immutable bucket policy that accepts only signed uploads).
- HMAC key recipient: please share the verification key with audit@northriverhealth.com and cc security@northriver.org. We will validate manifests during ingestion.
- Jurisdiction: No special EU redaction required for this dataset (all activity originates from US regions).
- For ephemeral traces: please preserve the debug-level operator traces for 90 days for this audit window (we will need two additional weeks beyond the snapshot date for spot checks).

We'd like the snapshot delivered by 2025-05-14 COB PST. Can you confirm you have the S3 details below?

S3 target: bucket: nrh-audit-uploads, prefix: 2025-05-12/nrh-soc2-2024-08-to-2025-04
Contact for key delivery: audit@northriverhealth.com

Sara
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@northriverhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, NorthRiver Procurement <procurement@northriverhealth.com>
Date: 2025-05-12T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit ledger preservation & export needs

Sara — confirming plan and timeline. Summary of commitments: 

1) Scope: admin/operator ledger for 2024-08-01 -> 2025-04-30, with debug-level operator traces retained and included for a 90-day extended window.
2) Snapshot schedule: generation started 2025-05-12 09:00 UTC; expected completion and delivery target 2025-05-14 22:00 UTC (meets your COB PST ask).
3) Packaging: JSONL shards (gz), CSV manifest (admin_activity_snapshot_manifest.csv), HMAC-SHA256-signed manifest.
4) Delivery: we will perform S3 presigned PUTs to your bucket: nrh-audit-uploads / 2025-05-12/nrh-soc2-2024-08-to-2025-04.
5) Verification: manifest and per-shard SHA256 checksums included. HMAC verification key will be sent to audit@northriverhealth.com as requested.

Operational notes / caveats:
- Ephemeral debug traces flagged for extension will be extracted before normal 30-day truncation; once the audit window closes we revert to standard retention unless you request continued retention under a signed addendum.
- Redaction: by default user-submitted content is redacted from admin traces; if you require plaintext content for specific records we will need signed approval and a brief scoped data access request.
- Chain-of-custody: we will include an export manifest with UTC timestamps and a Redwood operator signature line in the manifest header for attestation.

Attachments: redwood_audit_schema_v2.pdf (schema + field mapping), admin_activity_snapshot_manifest.csv (example stub), s3_presigned_instructions.txt (upload checklist).

Next steps: I will start the snapshot job and confirm S3 presigned objects in a separate email (will include TTL and presigned URLs). Kimberley (CC) — can you help with final attestations and provide the HMAC key rotation note for the manifest?

Thanks — Diego
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
